settings.title: Settings
settings.provider_help: Select the AI engine used for media analysis and tag generation. Ollama is standard for local operation.
settings.language_help: Switch application interface language between Japanese and English.
settings.ffmpeg_notice: Show notice when FFmpeg is not installed
settings.ffmpeg_notice_help: Toggle notice icon when FFmpeg (required for video processing) is missing.
settings.ollama_url_help: Connection URL for running Ollama server instance (default: http://localhost:11434).
settings.vlm_model_help: Vision model responsible for analyzing image content and video frames (e.g. minicpm-v, llama3.2-vision).
settings.force_detailed_help: Forcing detailed mode on smaller models (<8B) may cause parsing errors if the model fails complex JSON formatting. Recommended OFF (auto-falls back to LIGHT mode on failure).
settings.text_model_help: Language model for structured tag extraction & Japanese/English tag translation from VLM output (e.g. qwen2.5, llama3.1).
settings.unload_vram_help: Instantly unloads loaded Ollama models from GPU VRAM. Model will be purged even if used by other WebUI or applications.
settings.ollama_not_installed: Ollama is not installed or service is not running. Please start or install Ollama to use local VLM features.
settings.ollama_num_ctx_help: 0 = auto (8192-16384 depending on tag granularity). Thinking models such as qwen3-vl spend a large number of reasoning tokens before emitting the answer, so an undersized context truncates generation and returns an empty response, causing frequent retries. The context is automatically doubled when it runs out.
settings.ollama_max_image_edge_help: Downscales images to this longest edge before analysis (0 to disable). The aspect ratio is preserved. A 12MP photo alone costs about 4000 tokens, so downscaling frees up context and speeds up analysis. Raise this value if OCR accuracy matters more.
settings.llm_debug_logging_help: Logs prompt style, num_ctx, token usage and done_reason for each request, plus the raw response when analysis fails. Use it to investigate retries. Keep it OFF normally as it increases log volume.
settings.tag_granularity_help: Controls how much tags are decomposed when using the DETAILED prompt. Basic tags always stay at 5-10, while descriptive tags (e.g. "rain_soaked_tree") are added based on the granularity level.
settings.granularity_disabled_light: The current model uses the LIGHT prompt, so tag granularity does not apply. Open "Advanced settings" below and enable "Force Detailed Prompt" to use this setting.
settings.granularity_changed_notice: Tag granularity changed. The new setting only applies to media analyzed from now on. To align tags on existing media, re-analyze them from Folder Management.
settings.spectrum_help: Vectorizes tag meanings so you can find semantically related media even when tags do not match exactly. Vectorization is run manually and does not affect scanning.
settings.spectrum_model_missing: This model is not installed in Ollama. Install it from the cards above.
settings.spectrum_centering_help: When off, media with many tags tend to look similar to everything.
settings.spectrum_descriptive_help: When on, media analyzed with a high-accuracy model may preferentially match each other.
settings.spectrum_hub_corr: Correlation: tag count vs mean similarity

spectrum.title: Similar media
spectrum.notice_no_embeddings: Tag vectors have not been generated yet. Generate them from the settings screen.
spectrum.notice_base_not_eligible: This media has too few tags to compare. Add tags manually or re-analyze it.
spectrum.notice_not_enough: Not enough analyzed media to compare against yet.
spectrum.notice_degraded: Only the most similar results are shown because there are few candidates.
spectrum.reroll_help: Pick different media from each zone band
spectrum.badge_excluded: Excluded from similar-media search: fewer than {n} tags
